# Music

Every track is lo-fi jazz written in Strudel and played live in the browser. The tracks live in `src/audio/tracks.ts`. Press **M** in the game to turn music on.

- **Title screen** plays "Own Your Agent". The results screen plays it too.
- **Each world** has its own track, one per Mastra docs section, in a different key and tempo.
- **Layers grow with your agent.** At tier 1 (Raw LLM) you hear Rhodes chords over vinyl crackle. Each tier up adds a layer: upright bass, swung drums, a lead, then hats and top texture.
- **Boss variant.** When a boss arrives the world track speeds up by 16 bpm, the drums switch to a four-on-the-floor boss kit, and a pulsing bass and a dissonant stab come in, both in the world's key. It drops back when the boss is down.

Each world's track carries a small idea from its section: Memory echoes its lead, Workflows runs a step-by-step arpeggio, Guardrails keeps its lead in a narrow range, Evals ticks like a metronome, Observability pans its sparkles across the stereo field, Voice runs the lead through vowel filters, and Deployment walks its bass and runs fastest.

The links open each track in the Strudel REPL at full tier, so you can hear and edit it there. If you change a track, `npm run music-doc` prints a fresh table to paste here; a test fails if it is out of date.
